title: flv action
description: Converts a flat file of fixed-length values into XML. Every non-empty line is a record: the first rule whose matchOn the line starts with cuts it into the fields of its subcollection, by length. <flv> holds the records as elements named after the rule's name, else its matchOn; with group, consecutive records of a rule are collected in a <group>. A line no rule matches fails the message.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: JSON list of rules: {"matchOn": "HDR", "name": "", "group": false, "subcollection": [{"field": "header", "length": 3}, ...]}. A flow's DIL rules list is passed as this text
